whatsappMessage:
Hi Team S2 Unisex,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.7★ reviews across 450+ happy clients in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for instant appointment bookings.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, trending hairstyle showcase, aur service menu integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/s2unisex

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi S2 Unisex Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and a showcase of your top-rated beauty & grooming services in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
